source_qualifications: Nominal bleached Curauá fiber loadings are relative to total RPUF mass as reported in Conclusions, PDF page 12. They are not analyzed final mass fractions or cellulose purity.

Section 3.2, PDF page 11, reports freely expanding foam in an open plastic box, followed by 24 h curing at room conditions and cutting. Section 2, PDF page 7, describes at least 7 days post-curing in the thermal-conductivity discussion. Their exact relationship and the density measurement age are unresolved; neither is silently selected as density age.

Table 2, PDF page 5, calls superscripts coefficient of variance without an explicit unit. Preserve 0.4, 0.6 and 0.4 literally and the separate C/B/A statistical groups. Do not infer percent, SD, confidence interval or zero uncertainty. The existing typed uncertainty field is null because a supported uncertainty type/unit is not established, not because the source lacks variation information.

The ten samples per group are density-specific. Independence, batch count and repeats per sample are not established. Do not transfer the five mechanical samples, room-temperature viscosity, heat-flow mean temperature of 25 C or mechanical direction/rate to density.

The source calls Stepanpol PS-2352 a polyether polyol and lists nominal reactant amounts/NCO:OH. Retain source-qualified matrix identity only; do not validate product chemistry, reaction stoichiometry, bio-based fraction or final network composition from that wording.
